newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures closed slightly higher in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures closed slightly higher in dull trade.

text.p: FCOJ futures closed slightly firmer in the front months amid thin and rangebound trade, dealers said.

The benchmark September contract fell to support at 74.00 cents where trade buying emerged to support the market. Dealers said the contract should continue to work lower and pegged the near-term range between the life-of-contract low of 73.60 cents, and 76.00 cents basis September.
The most-active month settled 0.30 cent higher at 74.80 cents per lb, having ranged from 75.10 to 74.00 cents. The rest of the board finished 0.75 higher to 0.25 lower.
An estimated 1,550 lots changed hands on the day compared with Tuesday's official 1,182 lots. followed by 72.00 cents, analysts said.
